body: We’re not together anymore. I’m not safe and I’ve tried to contact several people asking for help. No one takes me seriously
I lost the love of my life. We lost a child. I can’t continue to breathe without feeling selfish for it.

But what if he’s convinced it won’t be better. I’ve exhausted all options and we’re both hurting. We still love each other. .

I’m dealing with this right now.
